title: Audited firmware rollout endpoint for an IoT fleet
name: Firmware rollout handler

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in what this code records in the audit trail? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
An operator from tenant A requests a firmware update for a device owned by tenant B. What does the caller see, and is anything recorded?
choices: 404 Not Found, and a 'denied' entry is recorded
202 Accepted, because the role check passes
404 Not Found, and nothing is recorded because the device is not theirs

questions.prompt: In AuditLog, each entry includes the previous entry's hash. What does this chain let an auditor detect?
choices: That an entry was edited or removed in the middle of the log, because later hashes would stop matching
Who wrote each entry, because the hash is a signature
That the sink lost an entry during a network outage, before append() returned
Nothing useful, because SHA-256 hashes are not unique

questions.prompt: scheduleFirmware() succeeds, but the audit sink then rejects. What does the client receive?
choices: 202, because the job was already scheduled
404, because the catch block treats every error as a missing device
An error, after the catch block tries to record a 'failed' entry, even though the job exists
